user.title: Add a pet
user.description: Each pet lives in its own handheld device on the dashboard's pet shelf. Add the integration again for every extra pet.

data_description.name: Shown on the card and used in entity IDs, for example button.pip_feed. Voice commands use it too.
data_description.world: Sets the device's look and which creatures can hatch. The egg picks one by surprise.

abort.no_worlds: No pet worlds are ready yet. Reinstall the integration files and try again.

init.title: What {name} notices
init.description: Connect parts of your home to the pet. Every field is optional, and anything you leave empty is ignored. The house never hurts the pet: it only changes its mood, its scene and what it asks for.

sleep.name: Sleep
sleep.description: Lights-out always wins. Otherwise the pet goes to bed when the bedtime lights are off and the house is quiet, from an hour before bedtime. If nobody does either, it dozes off on its own an hour after bedtime. The house never wakes it; it wakes at wake time.

data_description.bedtime: It gets drowsy 30 minutes before. Turning lights-out off after bedtime costs a little happiness.
data_description.wake_time: It wakes up on its own at this time.
data_description.bedtime_lights: When all of these are off, it's time for bed. Bedroom lights work well. A light left on late doesn't keep the pet up past its own bedtime.
data_description.motion: Indoor motion, occupancy or presence sensors. Movement in the last 10 minutes means the house isn't quiet yet.

weather.name: Weather and air
weather.description: Rain brings a rainy scene and a blanket request. Sun, snow and fog change its mood. Indoor temperature outside your comfort range makes it shiver or sweat and ask for a blanket or a fan.

data_description.rain: An on/off "it's raining" entity, or a rain rate where anything above 0 means rain. This beats the forecast, which only says what's likely.
data_description.weather: A weather entity. Used for sunny, snow and fog, and for rain when there's no rain sensor.
data_description.indoor_temperature: One temperature sensor in the main living space.
data_description.comfort_low: Below this the pet shivers and asks for a blanket. Never when the fireplace is lit.
data_description.comfort_high: Above this the pet sweats and asks for a fan.
data_description.aqi: An air quality index sensor. Above 100 the pet wears a little mask and stays in. Cosmetic only.
data_description.solar: Only if your weather station reports solar radiation in W/m². 300 or more counts as sunny, more precise than the forecast.

room.name: The pet's room
room.description: The room the pet lives in. Bright light late at night makes it squint; dim evening light makes it cozy. Daylight is never too bright.

data_description.room_lights: Lights in that room, for example the living room. Half brightness or more, from an hour before bedtime, counts as too bright.
data_description.fireplace: Any entity that's on, heating or above 0 when the fire is lit. The pet curls up by it, gets a little happier, and won't ask for a blanket.
data_description.lux: Optional. 100 lx or more at night also counts as too bright.

activity.name: People and activity
activity.description: Someone arriving gets an excited greeting, at most once every 30 minutes. When nobody is home for a while, the pet goes to the sitter's and time stops for it, so it never gets lonely or hungry. Music makes it dance and the TV makes it watch along, each with a small happiness bonus.

data_description.zone: The pet counts the people in this zone. Only people tracked in Home Assistant count.
data_description.away_after: How long the house has to be empty first.
data_description.sitter_settles: On: if the pet was whining for attention when it left (a fake call), the sitter settles it, so it comes home happy. Off: the whine waits for you. Real needs, like hunger, always wait.
data_description.tv: Media players that are TVs. On or playing counts as watching.
data_description.music: Speakers and displays. Playing anything that isn't video counts as music.

sky.name: Sky
sky.description: The full moon makes the pet happy if it's up late, and a new moon is a starry night. Any moon phase sensor works, such as the Moon integration's; or give the lit fraction instead.

data_description.moon_phase: A sensor whose state is the phase, like "full_moon" or "Full Moon".
data_description.moon_illumination: Optional. The lit fraction, 0–1 or a percentage; 97% or more counts as full.
data_description.moon_altitude: Optional. Degrees above the horizon; the moon only counts while it's up.

privacy.name: Privacy
privacy.description: For wall tablets and shared dashboards.

data_description.privacy: On: an empty house shows the pet napping, never at the sitter's, and the pet never names anyone. Off: dashboards show "at the sitter's".

error.comfort_range: "Too cold below" must be lower than "Too warm above".

no_pet.message: No virtual pet matches that config entry.

fast_forward.name: Fast forward
fast_forward.description: Debug tool: lives through the given number of hours right now, at normal rates. Calls left unanswered in that time count as care misses.

config_entry_id.name: Pet
config_entry_id.description: Which pet. Leave empty for all pets.

notify_me.name: Notify me
notify_me.description: Turns this pet's phone notifications on or off for you, the user calling it. They go to your phones through the Home Assistant app: calls, sickness, hatching, traits and new eggs.

enabled.name: Enabled
enabled.description: On to get notifications, off to stop.
